headline: Analysis: Czechia slightly worsened in the inflation ranking, with the 5th lowest in Europe | ČeskéNoviny.cz
summary: Czech year-on-year consumer price inflation rose to 1.7% in July from 1.5% in June. That was the fifth lowest among 42 monitored European countries, and all neighbours showed higher inflation.
why: Inflation readings guide central bank rate expectations, which influence government bond yields and the koruna exchange rate.
